direction.concept: The gathering seen from above: neighbors create an open horseshoe around a screen, and the date sits in the usable central aisle.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: A shallow-oblique overhead outdoor arrangement of seated adults on individual rectangular mats, a broad projection panel with an unmistakably visible illuminated face along the upper-right shoulder, a director and two listeners near one side, and the bridge's cast shadow across the paving. The connected seating arrangement fills much of the sheet.
direction.expression_system: A precise shallow-oblique overhead editorial drawing with complete bodies and mats, broad clean silhouettes and intentionally open aisles. Use the U-shaped gathering as the principal spatial system, rather than a grid of icons.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: First gaze: the prominent date inside the horseshoe and the surrounding audience. Next: time and the venue near the screen. Identity sits outside the seating arc; practical information occupies the two clear gaps at its lower ends.
direction.whole_visual_layout: Build a wide U across the middle 60% of the landscape canvas, leaving a central opening about 40% of the width. Screen and two discussion figures sit near the upper-right shoulder of the U. Identity is upper-left, activity/place upper-right, date/time central, and the two practical groups meet the open lower ends.
direction.typography_plan: Date 30–33 px and time 32–36 px at width 720; Korean title 28–32 px and English 17–19 px. Descriptor and every practical entry at least 17 px. All text stays horizontal on flat empty ground, using robust sans forms; no text follows perspective or curves.
direction.color_material_emotion: A sunny ochre ground, deep cobalt drawing and limited warm red accents make an inviting civic event. Flat matte edges keep bodies, mats and text distinct; the daylight-like diagram is a graphic explanation of the evening gathering, not a factual lighting record.
direction.distinction: After removing surface names, M2 is an overhead U with date/time inside its open floor and information distributed at its ends. M5 is a frontal lintel-and-piers structure with a huge vertical title and a narrow practical column.

reference_observations.observed_principle: The personally viewed cache has many distinct red figures on a dark field, each paired with a small bilingual name block. Repeated alignment creates order while different silhouettes, poses and occasional circular grounds vary the image rhythm; a much larger title anchors the base.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Make a repeated population feel like a real community while preserving deliberate clear information spaces. Reorganize repetition into one connected seating horseshoe, assign the largest type to the supplied date, and use no roster labels or borrowed characters.

reference_observations.observed_principle: Root observed purposeful grouping of event, joined date/time, place and access information in the actual public preview.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Keep the date/time as one useful decision group and give access/preparation separate readable homes within the overhead gathering.

direction.positive_construction: Draw the screen, the adult-sized mat-and-body units and their horseshoe relationship before adding copy. Preserve clear central and corner aisles large enough for the stated type sizes. Give the projection panel a visible illuminated face, not only its top edge; direct the microphone-bearing adult and nearby listeners visibly toward one another.

copy_groups.position_relationship: Upper-left outside the seating arc, about x4–43%, y6–25%; Korean title above its English companion.
Upper-right beside the screen, about x50–95%, y6–26%; descriptor may wrap at the middle dot, followed by venue.
Central open aisle, about x28–68%, y38–63%; date and time form the largest practical group.
Clear lower-left end of the U, x4–45%, y73–93%; two full entries with visible line separation.
Clear lower-right end of the U, x57–96%, y73–93%; parallel alignment with the left end, without adding labels.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Outdoor short-film screening and conversation must be recognizable, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
